title: Apply the /src/ path heuristic only without sourceDirs
goal: With conventions.sourceDirs set, only files in the named folders count as app code
acceptance: With sourceDirs set, a file counts as app code only inside a named folder, tested on its path relative to the repository root
A parent folder named src (the checkout path) or a stray src/ under tools/ or e2e/ no longer makes a file app code then; without the setting nothing changes
Fixture tests for both cases; CHANGELOG entry
privacy: Tool and procedure text only; fixtures are invented projects; no personal data.
escalation: A change to what a project without the setting checks is a major release; ask first

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25 at agent speed: found by the independent review of #254 (check-conventions.mjs, the app filter). Not a measurement. Implemented 2026-11-25 (failing-first fixture test committed before the fix), patch 10.11.2; review, CI and tag remain.
